notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug when the player jump in narrow areas.

- Movement speed of a zombie in Saint Cemetery was decreasing.

notes.title: Special Update
notes.content:
- The game is more balanced.

- Fixed a graphic bug in the portrait of some characters in the dialogues.

- Fixed the player stuck in knockback state.

- A new dog (the dog on the right in game) in World of Home. Don't forget to pet him by pressing up in keyboard or controller!
